name: Divine Armor of Protection
description: Armor blessed by the gods themselves, woven from divine threads and reinforced with the bones of fallen titans. This masterpiece provides unparalleled protection while enhancing the wearer's divine connection.

special_materials.description: Silk spun by celestial spiders in the heavens
Bones from ancient titans that once ruled the world
Crystals blessed by multiple divine entities
Feathers from the wings of archangels

unique_properties.description: Creates a holy aura that damages undead enemies
Amplifies divine spells and prayers by 50%
Regenerates 15 health per second for nearby allies
